episode: episodes/10_彼此的天上/01_不存在的夜行路
story_os_target: Story OS V2.2.8 Photography Continuity Rules
scope: Frame 11-20 only; 01-10 treated as completed continuity prehistory; NOT full production
reuse_rule: 01-10 仅作为连续性前史锚点；禁止复用 01-10 任何图片作为 11-20 输出

handoff_reasons.12: P01 驾驶座双手需操作灯光拨杆，不适合持机；P02 在副驾用自己手机记录
handoff_reasons.14: P02 用自己手机站在 P01 身后拍摄，P01 入镜需要第二拍摄源
handoff_reasons.16: P01 需双手举稳手机对准最后一盏灯，P02 用自己的手机记录拍摄者
handoff_reasons.19: P01 无法拍摄自己手机屏幕（物理禁止），P02 用自己的手机拍屏幕回放

camera_roster.ghost_camera_rule: 每帧必须能解释相机为何在此人手里；所有同行者完整入镜时必须有真实来源（第二摄影者/自拍/交机），禁止幽灵摄影机

shot_grammar_diversity.rule: 第一人称是摄影逻辑，不是固定手+手机+远山构图

visual_profile.profile_name: 2020s 川西自驾手机相册纪实
visual_profile.authority_source: episodes/10_彼此的天上/01_不存在的夜行路/docs/04_不存在的夜行路_视觉规范_DRAFT_V1.0.md

visual_dna.color: environment-driven low/medium saturation, no teal-orange, no excessive HDR
visual_dna.texture: phone album grain, low-light digital noise, telephoto smear, causal motion blur only
visual_dna.anomaly: same terrain before/after difference; real life appearing where it should not be; cultural avoidance of fireless light

capture_grammar.text:
capture_grammar=FIRST_PERSON_CASUAL_SNAPSHOT_V1
principle=摄影者必须属于事件现场。默认第一人称或同行者持机私人记录，非摆拍，构图有生活性缺陷。
operator=participant_or_companion_inside_event
handheld=true
unposed=true
imperfect_framing=true
first_person_is_logic_not_fixed_composition=true
phone_in_frame_not_required=true
camera_roster.primary_photographer_required=true
camera_roster.secondary_requires_reason=true
camera_roster.all_known_participants_visible_rule=all visible requires a real camera source; otherwise ghost camera
ghost_camera_forbidden=true
shot_diversity.avoid_same_shot_family_more_than_consecutive=2
shot_diversity.ten_frame_distinct_families_min=4
camera_defect_physics.defects_must_have_physical_cause=true
camera_defect_physics.forbid_every_night_frame_equally_blurred=true
visual_memory.time_of_day_must_progress_plausibly=true
visual_memory.no_independent_beauty_time_selection_per_frame=true
screen_content_physics.forbid_fake_impossible_camera_ui=true
forbidden=omniscient_third_person_camera; director_blocking; staged_group_lineup; symmetrical_hero_framing; poster_composition; commercial_promo_composition; characters_arranged_for_camera; floating_camera_outside_human_position; camera_capture_ui_on_phone_screen

frames.story_beat: 女友提议闪灯，车内近景，建立主动选择
远光一次，副驾机位记录灯光拨杆与挡风玻璃外
灯队第一个人停，车外长焦记录人类响应
消息传开，肩后机位拍人正在应对
灯一盏盏灭，隔车窗长焦，文化避让成立
最后一盏灯，拍摄者入镜，阶段高潮
两人离开，车内低光出发瞬间，失控与后怕
第二天同山坡，白天无路强证据
昨晚视频还在，屏幕回看，证据残留
普通山坡收尾，双人自拍，私人相册最后一张
